What we offer

Our Services

From intricate nail art to full bridal packages,every service crafted with care and precision.

Nail Extensions

Acrylic & gel extensions sculpted to your desired length strong, flawless, and long-lasting.

₹1,500 – ₹3,000

Gel Polish

Chip-free, glossy gel finish in hundreds of shades. Lasts 3–4 weeks with zero maintenance.

₹500 – ₹900

Nail Art (Basic – 3D)

From minimal florals to intricate 3D designs fully customized and designed just for you.

₹500 – ₹2,000+

French Tips

Classic and modern French tips clean, elegant, timeless. Perfect for any occasion.

₹600 – ₹1,200

Nail Refill & Maintenance

Keep your extensions looking fresh with our professional refill and upkeep sessions.

₹700 – ₹1,500

Nail Removal

Safe, gentle removal of gel or acrylic without any damage to your natural nails.

₹200 – ₹400

Manicure

Full hand care ritual- shaping, cuticle care, scrub, massage, and a perfect polish finish.

₹400 – ₹900

Pedicure

Heated foot soak, callus care, deep moisturising massage, and a flawless colour finish.

₹500 – ₹1,200

Bridal Makeup

Long-wear bridal looks tailored to your style. Consultation and trial session available.

Mehendi Services
